results.description:
Allie Ross’s life is not going according to plan.
Her law career crashed before it started.
Her parents landed in prison for running a Ponzi scheme.
And she just inherited her grandmother’s quirky B&B—
complete with a crew of extra-toed cats.
Her love life? Don’t ask.
Then Jack Carpenter shows up.
The ex she never got over.
The guy she once loved—and hated—in college.
He’s older, steadier, and still sinfully sexy.
Jack’s a single dad now, and determined to prove he’s not the deadbeat he once was.
And Allie’s not the golden girl he remembers.
But the spark between them? Still very much alive.
As they reconnect, old feelings resurface.
So do old secrets—along with some new ones that could wreck them both.
Can Allie and Jack stop history from repeating itself?
Or are they doomed to crash and burn all over again?
One-click this emotional, witty second-chance romance about messy pasts, unexpected reunions, and the one who got away walking right back into your heart.
